messages.content: Hi

hi, i’m tal

i help people find the best ‘next job’
i scan 50,000 roles a day to find the best 1 for you.

so… what’s your full name?
Kirthi Sagar
which company are you working at?
Cisco
what's your role at cisco?
Technical Consulting Engineer

interesting.

is this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/b-kirthi-sagar
Yes

three years deep in the cisco trenches, right out of college.

you didn't just take a job, you went straight for the complex stuff... sd-wan, routing, the things most engineers avoid. that's not a job, that's a specialty.

how many years have you been at it, total?
My overall work experience is 4

I've got a sense for what you're looking for. Be back in less than a minute
i'm scanning through 50,000 jobs to find the perfect fit for you. you'll hear from me soon.

Cloud Platform Engineer at Accenture in India

accenture is hiring a cloud platform engineer in bengaluru.

pay is likely a standard service co deal, maybe 25-30 lpa, nothing wild.

it's a direct fit for your azure and networking skills, but you're not building core product, you're parachuting into client projects.

good for the brand on your cv, but you'll be swimming in more powerpoint decks than actual code.
Will 4 yoe be enough for this job?

yeah, more than enough.

job descriptions are a fantasy wish list from hr. especially at service companies.

they're looking for your exact skillset – cloud and networking. they know they'll have to train you on the specifics for whatever client they throw you at.

the real question is if you want the service co life.

<caption></caption>
    <analysis>{
  "transcription": "I think you not. I have been in the customer experience or service-based role but I would like to feature I would like to venture into you know product development side especially networking and cloud.",
  "language": "English",
  "tone": "Informal",
  "backgroundSounds": "None"

ah, the classic pivot.

you've done your time in the support trenches. you want to build the thing, not just fix it when it breaks.

got it. this is a much sharper filter. no more accenture-type roles.

i'll focus on pure product companies. this changes the game.
Thanks, looking forward

of course.

my crawlers are always running. the good stuff is rare, but it's out there.

the cisco to cisco product dev jump is the toughest one. everyone wants it.
